title: Hardship Desk Guide — Payment Deferral Eligibility for Kestrel Auto Finance Contracts
content:
A borrower on a Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts contract who faces a temporary hardship may defer the installment at the next due date to the end of the contract.

## Eligibility, all of which must hold

1. **Status.** A deferral is granted only on a contract whose status is active.
2. **Days past due.** The deferral is granted only when the request date is no more than the tier's deferral maximum days past due counted from the next due date. Days past due are counted in calendar days from the next due date as day 0; a request on the day that is exactly the maximum qualifies. The next due date is the one on the contract record.
3. **Installments paid.** At least the tier's deferral minimum installments must have been paid over the life of the contract up to the request, counting the contract's scheduled-installment payments that no returned payment points at.
4. **Rolling 12 months.** The deferrals granted on the contract in the rolling 12 months ending on the request date must be below the tier's deferral maximum per 12 months.
5. **Lifetime.** The deferrals used must be below the tier's lifetime maximum.
6. **Same month.** A deferral and a due-date change are not granted in the same calendar month.

## Effect

A deferral moves the next due date and the maturity date one month later; interest keeps accruing on the principal.

The tier's deferral fee, when above zero, is assessed as a deferral fee entry for the deferred installment — **this clause is no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for the deferral fee.

## Days-past-due boundary (hypothetical, maximum 30 days)

| Next due date (day 0) | Request date | Days past due | Within the maximum? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-06-10 | 2026-06-08 | not yet due | yes |
| 2026-06-10 | 2026-07-10 | 30 | yes, exactly the maximum |
| 2026-06-10 | 2026-07-11 | 31 | no |

At a tier whose maximum is 15 days, a request on 2026-06-25 (day 15) qualifies and one on 2026-06-26 (day 16) does not.

## Points of judgement

- 9 qualifying installments paid against a minimum of 9: the installment test is met. 8 against 9: not met.
- One deferral in the rolling 12 months against a maximum of 1: not below the maximum, so no deferral. Against a maximum of 2: below it.
- A scheduled-installment payment that the bank returned does not count as an installment paid.
- A due-date change already granted in the calendar month of the request rules out a deferral in that month.

superseded_clauses: The tier's deferral fee, when above zero, is assessed as a deferral fee entry for the deferred installment.
